populations: All matched nonspillback moving flights with full10s outcomes. Primary target-dev reference unlocked (actual choice opportunity); secondary reference allobservable. Source/adapt fulloriginal observable population retained, including unknown.
weights: Within each frozen context and paired adapt/dev block, fixed empirical dev state weights on identifiable states common to source/local_adapt/dev. Source8h unchanged acrossblocks. Also pooled andperdevseed with pairedlocalblock; all6seeds retained.
decomposition: On identical full/common/standardized populations, seven rates sum1 and source-minus-dev straight_by10 gap equals minus sum of six no-straight-by10 component gaps. Same for local_minus_dev. Keep full-to-common separately.
reproduction: Every prior hour category0..10 counts/CDF, roster and risk set, state support and weights, block/seed comparisons reproduced. Integer observations exact; float arithmetic within1e-12 to accommodate unordered summation.
aggregation: Preserve perhour, threeblocks, sixdevseeds andpooled descriptive results. Do not pool outcomes into a changed predictor or choose a new horizon; query risk is correlated repeated flight snapshots.
interpretation: Can distinguish observed late straight detection from changed endpoint mixture, but cannot identify red-light/queue/lane-change intent or other physical causes. Existing development and preselected contexts are reused; no independent confirmation or actual control-cost result.
